posts.text:
Early Vote Update, 10/29/26. Highlights via TargetEarly:  
- Turnout is running 16% higher than 2022
- Electorate is 12 points more D now (53%-39% now, 46%-44% this point in 2024).  Consistent with Dem gains in generic ballot/Party ID.  
- Youth, Black, Hispanic turnout is 🔥 https://t.co/lRfoTDGIbt
